Pushed successfully.

Implements issue #132 ([approval-baseline 03/03] Show one global approval queue): adds a single cross-project approval queue.

**Backend**: `GET /api/approval-requests` joins pending approval requests with their agent run and source project, returning a client-safe summary (arg keys only, never argument values — verified with a dedicated test).

**Frontend**: new `ApprovalQueue` view (`?page=approvals&user=<id>`) listing tool, risk class, safe arg summary, requested time, source project, and agent run for every pending request across all projects, with explicit Approve/Reject actions. Handles loading/empty/error states via the shared conventions, per-row malformed-payload placeholders, per-row action errors, and renders the authoritative decided state (with a race note) instead of treating a raced zero-row update as an error.

All checks pass: backend lint/format/build/migration-numbering, backend unit (83/83), integration (650/650), and e2e (5/5) tests; web lint/format/build, web tests (120/120).
